basics.name: Arnav Mahadeshwar
basics.label: AI & ML Engineer
basics.summary: Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) engineer with 1+ year of professional experience shipping production systems across applied AI, full-stack development, and cloud infrastructure. Built AI underwriting and automated deployment infrastructure at a Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) serving 100K+ customers, then delivered a six-site operations platform end-to-end as the sole engineer on a freelance contract. Strengths: Python, TypeScript, Next.js, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Docker, Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD), and Large Language Model (LLM) application design.

projects.name: MuddleArt Private Limited
projects.description: India's first formal, tech-enabled pre-consumer textile waste recycler, operating 6 factory units across Gujarat, Delhi, and Uttar Pradesh. Replace manual coordination with one system of record for daily material dispatch, multi-team approvals, and partner-facing impact reporting.
highlights: Architected a serverless backend (Google Apps Script) with a webhook gateway, role-based dispatch engine, and scheduled cron jobs orchestrating daily logistics across 6 factory units, eliminating 10+ hours/week of manual coordination
Integrated Meta WhatsApp Business API for interactive button-based approvals and template messaging across 4 operational teams (logistics, transport, bags, labour), processing 100+ messages per month
Built the Next.js partner portal (Tailwind CSS, TanStack Query, Chart.js) with a token-gated live dashboard, material breakdown, and collective impact tracking

Engineered a 3-stage data pipeline (Staging → Confirmation → Master Ledger) with nightly archival and automated environmental impact reporting (carbon dioxide avoided, water saved, employment generated)
Outcome: Handed over documented and operational as the client's daily source of truth for dispatch, with the impact dashboard live for partners.

highlights: Designed a multi-tenant PostgreSQL schema (9+ migrations) with full Row-Level Security (RLS) for campaigns, compendium, and character data

Built a 29-rule parser engine extracting structured automation hooks from unstructured rules text, plus an active-effect dependency graph computing armor class, saves, and skill modifiers in real time
Implemented an admin ingestion pipeline for spells, monsters, items, and class data via JavaScript Object Notation (JSON)

projects.name: Resume-as-Code — This Resume's Build Pipeline
highlights: Built the pipeline that generates this document: one resume.yaml source of truth compiled by Python and Jinja2 into four artifacts — an interactive web resume, an Applicant Tracking System (ATS)-optimized print document, print-ready Portable Document Format (PDF) files, and a JSON Resume export — deployed to GitHub Pages on every git push

Engineered a dual-face stylesheet where one Document Object Model (DOM) renders as a dark terminal interface on screen and re-flows into a two-column print document, with no duplicated content and one line of JavaScript
Gated the build on an automated ATS contract: Continuous Integration asserts the extracted text layer stays linear, dates stay complete, and no draft placeholder or dead link can reach a recruiter
